newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-FISICHELLA TO PARTNER SCHUMACHER IN JORDAN TEAM.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FISICHELLA TO PARTNER SCHUMACHER IN JORDAN TEAM.

text.p: Italian driver Giancarlo Fisichella will partner Ralf Schumacher at Jordan this season after signing a two-year contract with the British team.
Fisichella, 23, made his Formula One debut with the Minardi team at last year's Australian Grand Prix.
Fisichella's signing was a blow to experienced F1 driver Martin Brundle who had been hoping to partner Schumacher.

"I am very, very disappointed," he said. "I've got complicated proposals in my bag that I have been thrashing out with Jordan for months. It's a strange decision. They already had one inexperienced driver, now they have two."
Brundle, a veteran of 158 grands prix, added: "I like to think I will race again but who knows."
